multiplan.title: Software Engineer
multiplan.item1: Led frontend development for a high-traffic smart parking platform serving 100k+ daily active users and storing data from over 2M licensed plates, acting as the primary engineer for the product's core user-facing layer.
multiplan.item2: Drove a 200% increase in registered users — from 100k to 300k+ — in 6 months by engineering the client-side orchestration of a multi-provider payment system with Sem Parar, ConectCar, and Veloe, delivering a frictionless checkout experience.
multiplan.item3: Optimized application performance by refactoring the caching strategy with React Apollo Client, achieving a 70% reduction in API requests and a measurably faster UX.
multiplan.item4: Boosted user retention by 23% by migrating EV Charger communications from WebSockets to Polling, resolving critical real-time sync issues under a tight production deadline.
multiplan.item5: Decreased critical errors by 20% and reduced operational costs by increasing test coverage by 30% and implementing advanced observability with MixPanel and BugSnag.
multiplan.item6: Architected a daily cron job for vehicle tier migration using Node.js, orchestrating communication between monolith and microservices via GraphQL with batch processing and Promise.allSettled for fault-tolerant, scalable execution.

multiplan_jr.title: Software Engineer Jr
multiplan_jr.item1: Developed and launched an end-to-end MVP for an automated License Plate Recognition (LPR) system using Node.js and React, scaling to 30k+ active users within the first month of production.
multiplan_jr.item2: Reduced user processing time by 90% — from 10 minutes to under 60 seconds — by engineering an automated parking exemption system deployed across 6+ major malls, eliminating physical tickets for partner businesses such as gyms and supermarkets.
multiplan_jr.item3: Architected internal backoffice tooling for A/B testing and Feature Flags, empowering Product and Marketing teams to run experiments independently and reducing engineering bottlenecks in the product release cycle.

pepsico.title: Software Engineer
pepsico.item1: Designed and delivered a freight logistics platform for PepsiCo, enabling real-time visibility and data synchronization across multiple national distribution centers.
pepsico.item2: Eliminated redundant network traffic and improved resource allocation for critical logistics features by refactoring the data synchronization layer with React Query, directly improving platform reliability.
pepsico.item3: Engineered a 10-minute periodic synchronization mechanism for regional fleet monitoring, ensuring real-time dashboard accuracy across distribution hubs while optimizing network overhead.

neurogram.title: Software Engineer
neurogram.item1: Integrated medical diagnostic algorithms into an EEG exam platform, enabling complex neurological data processing to support clinical decision-making for healthcare professionals.
neurogram.item2: Developed high-performance dynamic landing pages using React, optimizing for product-driven user experience and conversion.
neurogram.item3: Automated deployment cycles by implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Firebase, increasing deployment frequency and ensuring infrastructure scalability.
